dashboard.label: TA-netqual Overview
dashboard.description: Collects per-interface link quality from /sys/class/net and /proc/net/dev: carrier/operstate, negotiated speed, MTU, cumulative RX/TX error and drop counters per physical

panel.html: Commercial Use Commercial or production use of TA-netqual requires a paid license. Evaluation, personal, and lab use is free. See the BentleyPC Commercial License for full terms. Buy License License & Terms

search.query: | mstats avg("netqual.iface_total") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
index=main sourcetype="netqual:status" | eventstats latest(_time) as lt by host | dedup host lt | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"carrier\":\s*(?<c>[0-9]+)" | mvexpand c | stats sum(c) as value
| mstats avg("netqual.*_carrier") as "v*" where index=metrics by host, metric_name span=5m | stats last(v*) as "v*" by host | rename v* as "netqual.*_carrier"

panel.title: Interfaces - negotiated speed (Mb/s), latest per host

search.query: | mstats avg("netqual.*_speed_mbps") as "v*" where index=metrics by host, metric_name span=5m | stats last(v*) as "v*" by host | rename v* as "netqual.*_speed_mbps"
| mstats avg("netqual.*_rx_errors") as "v*" where index=metrics by host, metric_name span=5m | stats last(v*) as "v*" by host | rename v* as "netqual.*_rx_errors"
| mstats avg("netqual.*_rx_dropped") as "v*" where index=metrics by host, metric_name span=5m | stats last(v*) as "v*" by host | rename v* as "netqual.*_rx_dropped"
| mstats avg("netqual.*_tx_errors") as "v*" where index=metrics by host, metric_name span=5m | stats last(v*) as "v*" by host | rename v* as "netqual.*_tx_errors"
| mstats avg("netqual.*_tx_dropped") as "v*" where index=metrics by host, metric_name span=5m | stats last(v*) as "v*" by host | rename v* as "netqual.*_tx_dropped"
index=main sourcetype="netqual:status" | spath input=_raw output=x path=link_flaps{} | where isnotnull(x) AND x!="" | mvexpand x | rename x as "interface" | table host "interface"
